title: Rebuild the ops dashboard on the warehouse
variant: Technical: dense, mono figures, before and after
prompt: A one-pager pitching the rebuild of our internal ops dashboard, for the CTO.
note: Technical register, dense and all sans with monospace touches on the figures, the before and after labels, and a mono meta line in the header, because a CTO reads this in a minute between meetings and wants the numbers to look like numbers. The proposal is a before-and-after pair instead of a three-column band, costs are in engineer-weeks and returns in hours a week with the arithmetic shown, and the risks strip carries a mono fix tag on each mitigation.
